item.title: Zoo Open Mic : All Genre Open Mic
item.description:
Monday, August 24, 2026 at 12 PM

This is an open invitation to share your words, sounds, or performances. Whether you bring poetry, music, or performance art, we welcome what is passionate, heartfelt, and experimental. Together we’ll continue the legacy of Notsuoh as a space where creative energy is nurtured, community is built, and experimentation is ALIVE & KICKING! Come to perform, or come to listen and be part of the community (or come take pictures! We love our photographers!) .
